applicability: Every directory the notes listing walk enters below the resolved notes root, including the target of an in-root directory symlink.
conditions: The platform provides O_DIRECTORY, O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd opens and os.scandir on a descriptor.
exclusions: A directory renamed out of the root after its descriptor was opened: its own entries are still listed (whoever can move it could place the same content inside the root).
The per-symlink stat-before-check window, which the symlink-only confinement clause states.
Open errors other than ELOOP/ENOTDIR, which propagate as the path-based walk's did.
statement: The notes listing enters every directory through a descriptor opened with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW relative to its already-confined parent (in-root directory symlinks component-wise from the root descriptor), so a directory replaced by a symlink or file after it was observed is refused (ELOOP/ENOTDIR) rather than followed out of the notes root.
